method: Mean paired MiniLM cosine over scorable references with a nonmissing, non-wholly-unknown prediction; missing/unknown answers are N/A and excluded from this mean. Report with valid-pair coverage. Not percent accuracy.

metric_definition.cosine: Mean paired MiniLM cosine over scorable references with a nonmissing, non-wholly-unknown prediction; missing/unknown answers are N/A and excluded from this mean. Report with valid-pair coverage. Not percent accuracy.
metric_definition.missing_or_unknown_only: N/A per line; excluded from primary cosine denominator
metric_definition.coverage: valid_pairs / scorable_references; unknown/missing counts cover scorable references only
metric_definition.partial_unknown: Existing partial_unknown predictions remain scored and are counted separately. No new semantic classification is performed. Tentative guesses, unresolved aliases, and structure-only glosses may still receive cosine scores; nonzero similarity does not establish decipherment.
metric_definition.zero_inclusive_cosine: Supplementary historical mean including missing/unknown as zero; unchanged
metric_definition.unknown_reference: Unscorable; excluded from both primary mean and coverage denominator

metric_definition.bleu: Existing add-one-smoothed BLEU-4; macro sentence mean plus corpus BLEU
metric_definition.rouge: Mean sentence ROUGE-1/2/L F1; existing ASCII word tokenizer
metric_definition.missing_or_unknown_only: Zero per-line scores, retained in scorable-reference denominator
metric_definition.unknown_reference: Confidence unknown or wholly unknown English: unscorable, explicitly counted
metric_definition.unknown_detection: Lexical marker heuristic; partial unknown answers remain scored; explicit whole-content abstentions additionally normalized by the audited extraction adapter
metric_definition.cosine: Paired MiniLM cosine; absent/wholly unknown hypotheses receive zero
